images.filename: USDA AMS and Gallaudet Univ MOU (20161202-AMS-KM-0002).jpg
images.caption: The memorandum of understanding (MOU) between Gallaudet University and United States Department of Agriculture’s (USDA) Agricultural Marketing Service (AMS) ready for signatures at Gallaudet University in Washington, DC on Friday, December 2, 2016. The MOU will increase the number of qualified college graduates who apply for full-time employment and internship positions at the USDA. Gallaudet University, federally chartered in 1864, is a bilingual, diverse, multicultural institution of higher education that ensures the intellectual and professional advancement of deaf and hard of hearing individuals through American Sign Language and English. USDA Photo by Ken Melton
